description: With include-unsupported-proxy: h2-connect, naive, vmess ws with v2ray-http-upgrade and a path carrying ?ed=2048 beside both early-data keys, http with headers, vmess over http, and ss over TLS without a plugin. Stash keeps every type and gives the http-upgrade node the early-data handling, Surge writes vmess over http as tcp and ss over TLS as a plain ss line, Quantumult X writes the http node without its headers.
